summary: Tested distance calculation and travel fee features. All features working correctly: Google Maps Routes API calculates distance from customer address to Burleson TX, travel fee ($1/mile beyond 15 miles) is automatically added to pricing, displayed in Order Summary sidebar, and included in booking total. Quote follow-up endpoints working.
passed_tests: Distance calculation API - Arlington TX (29.7 miles outside free radius) returns correct distance and travel fee
Distance calculation API - Burleson TX (0.3 miles within free radius) returns no travel fee
Price calculation API includes travel fee in total
Booking creation with travel fee - travel fee persisted to database
Booking within free radius - no travel fee charged
Quote service booking with travel fee - travel fee applies even to quote services
Admin pending-quotes endpoint returns quote bookings
Admin mark quote responded endpoint updates booking
Admin process-followups endpoint works for 24hr follow-ups
Frontend distance info displayed under address field
Frontend travel fee shown in Order Summary sidebar
Frontend total correctly includes travel fee
Frontend shows 'Within free service area - no travel fee!' for local addresses
Pay Now button shows correct total with travel fee included
Email confirmation box shows when email provided
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Distance calculation uses Google Routes API (with Distance Matrix fallback). Travel fee is $1/mile beyond 15-mile free radius from Burleson, TX. Quote follow-up system sends 24hr auto follow-up if admin hasn't responded. All integrations are REAL (Google Maps, Resend email, Twilio SMS). Customer emails to non-verified addresses fail in Resend sandbox mode which is expected.

distance_calculation.details: Uses Google Routes API with Distance Matrix fallback, calculates driving distance to Burleson TX

travel_fee.ui_display: Shown in Order Summary sidebar and under address input
travel_fee.persistence: Saved to booking record in database
